1.why: All six screens are static, flat cards with no animations, carousels, or pop-up overlays; only fixed inline notices appear.

2.why: Each screen has one bold heading and a single high-contrast teal primary button, though the large dark 'Logs' panel competes for visual attention.

3.why: Each step presents one labelled field and one action, so the needed control is immediately visible without scrolling or navigation.

4.why: The flow requires carrying a 64-character reset token, a six-digit MFA code, and a 14-character password rule set across five sequential steps with no persistence aids.

5.why: No password manager hint, autofill affordance, 'remember me' checkbox, or show-password toggle appears on any screen, including the password creation step.

6.why: Nothing familiar or saved is displayed—no masked email/phone hint, no remembered contact, and the token only appears in a raw developer log.

7.why: Instructions are one or two short sentences in high-contrast, readable sans-serif type, though terms like 'MFA code' and 'simulated recovery delivery' add jargon.

8.why: No error or validation message is shown in any of the six screenshots, so the claim cannot be observed as true of this system.

9.why: The password rules line and the 'Email address or phone contact' placeholder give partial guidance, but the recovery-code and MFA fields have no example format shown.

10.why: Fields are clearly labelled ('Recovery code', 'New password', 'MFA code'), but no alternative login choices such as face or biometric login are offered at all.

11.why: Every screen offers exactly one input and one primary action, with at most a single secondary 'Start over' link.

12.why: The final screen clearly confirms 'Password reset complete', but intermediate steps give no explicit success message (e.g., code verified) beyond advancing the page.

13.why: Short helper text, the blue password-rules note, and the recurring safety reminder provide tips for each new step.

14.why: 'Start over' is available on the verify-code screens and 'Begin another recovery session' at the end, but the password and MFA screens offer no back or retry link.

15.why: Header, card layout, typography, button styling, safety reminder, log panel, and footer are identical across all six steps.
